articles.title: Quote of the day by Maya Angelou: 'Forgive yourself for not knowing what only time could teach...' - Powerful lesson on not to blame yourself for past mistakes by the iconic American writer-activist
articles.description: Maya Angelou's powerful quote, “Forgive yourself for not knowing what only time could teach,” offers a simple lesson about self-forgiveness, mistakes and personal growth. The quote reminds us that we often judge our past decisions using knowledge and experience we gained later in life. Her own journey, from a difficult childhood to becoming a celebrated author, poet and civil rights activist, reflects how experiences can shape a person's understanding and strength.

articles.title: Jennifer Aniston's Japanese-inspired garden has a simple lesson: 7 budget-friendly ways to recreate the aesthetics in your home
articles.description: Jennifer Aniston’s Japanese-inspired garden offers budget-friendly ideas for creating a calm outdoor space. Beginners can recreate the aesthetic with layered greenery, natural stones, bamboo, simple pathways and a small water feature instead of expensive landscaping. Keeping colours restrained and leaving open spaces can make even small gardens feel peaceful. Rather than copying Aniston’s entire garden, choose one focal area and adapt its Japanese-inspired elements to your space and budget.
